exports.normalizeResolvedSecretInputString: Records explicit dummy value/path and trims strings only. No real secret resolution or credential authority executes.

exports.resolveGeneratedMediaMaxBytes: Records cfg/media kind and returns a fixed positive fixture allowance. Original media settings, cap and overflow semantics are unexecuted.

exports.assertOkOrThrowProviderError: Records the synthetic successful response identity and label only. Original status/error behavior is unexecuted.
exports.readProviderBinaryResponse: Records response identity/label/kind/reader options and returns fresh opaque fixture audio bytes. Original body reader, limits and deadlines are unexecuted.
exports.readProviderJsonResponse: Records response identity/label and returns fresh positive fixture voice JSON. Original reader and malformed/error behavior are unexecuted.

exports.ssrfPolicyFromHttpBaseUrlAllowedHostname: Records the source-produced URL and supplies an opaque named fixture policy. No hostname or network policy algorithm executes.
exports.fetchWithSsrFGuard: Records exact source URL, SSML/headers/timeout/audit fields and returns a synthetic 200 response plus counted release. No network or guard implementation executes.

exports.rmSync: Linked solely for complete original module evaluation; never invoked by these ordinary recipes.

globalBoundaries.process: Isolated VM process.env={} only. Original route/key code can read these absent fields as provenance; no ambient env values, credential fallback or configured predicate is qualified.
globalBoundaries.fetch: Throwing ambient binding; only the explicitly named synthetic successful guarded-fetch facade is invoked.
globalBoundaries.Buffer: Node native Buffer carries synthetic opaque fixture audio unchanged; this does not establish a real media format or codec.
globalBoundaries.clock: Successful source callbacks pass timeout values to a synthetic boundary; no actual timer, timeout, retry, cancellation or recovery semantics are qualified.

limits: All 58558 pinned tracked blobs/modes are verified before and after; complete original executable modules match pinned Git bytes before TypeScript erasure only.

Whole-module evaluation is not all-branch execution. Original factory, metadata, config/Talk/overrides, full SSML construction, buffered synthesis, telephony and ordered voice catalog callbacks execute ordinary recipes.
The actual normalization modules preserve source nullish-before-trim aliases, finite-number treatment, explicit route precedence/inheritance and config-first timeout selection.

Source formats retain original spelling and classify MP3/Ogg/WebM/WAV/PCM/AMR/custom extension metadata; generic telephony target is distinct from the forced raw8000mulaw dedicated callback. No actual media codec is involved.

Original directive parser construction executes only; directive policy dispatch and isConfigured/isConfiguredAsync are never invoked. Source env reads see an empty isolated object and remain provenance only.

Original first-nonblank explicit dummy-key helper and source request headers execute as provenance, not authentication/credential/security qualification. Real secret resolution, guarded HTTP and response/body readers are named positive synthetic facades.

Voices preserve source order, duplicate IDs, normalized public fields and untrimmed accepted tag strings. Deprecated/disabled/malformed filtering branches are not qualified by the permitted positive inputs.
Manifest, index, capability catalog and license are complete source provenance only; plugin activation/registration is not executed.
No Azure SDK, retry runner, preparation stage, streaming or transcoder exists in this provider. No real HTTP, supplier, codec, playback, channel routing or host production installation executes.
No security/permission/authTLS, negative/error/failure/cancel/crash, mixed, budget/truncation/eviction/threshold/race, real provider or remote MCP execution.
